fights.notes: Referee Eph Holland gave the fight to Goss on a foul in round 21, after Allen's blow as Goss fell; Allen protested. The fight began at a riverside site and moved by train after the militia threat. Date of the fight is not printed (card is dated 8 September).

notes: Hints checked: fight, foul, quote and card claims kept. Fight date not printed, so month precision. Allen's home town is not stated (St. Louis appears only in Tom Kelly's party and the crowd's framing), so no residence claim.
